[GCT-POL-159 §1] Network Incident Communications (GCT Wholesale) - Severity levels
A P1 incident is defined as any event that impacts more than 7 sites or more than 25,000 customers. A P2 incident is recognized when the impact exceeds 8,000 customers but does not meet the P1 criteria. The classification guides the escalation and response processes.

When a P1 incident is detected, the executive on-call must be notified within 20 minutes. This rapid notification ensures that senior leadership can coordinate the response and allocate resources promptly. All notifications must be logged in the incident management system.
</evidence>

Status updates shall be issued at intervals of 60 minutes until full service restoration is achieved. Each update must include the current impact, actions taken, and an estimated time to resolution. The updates are communicated to both internal stakeholders and affected customers.
